title: MissionForge part category file
description: A part category and its options.

$schema.description: Optional relative path to the JSON Schema of this file, for editor support. Loaders ignore it.

category.description: Category of every part in the file; must equal the file name without extension.

name_key.description: String key of the category name shown in the vote Reveal step.

intro_key.description: String key of the one-sentence "why it matters" line, where the design gives one.

design_section.description: Design section the table comes from, for example 7.7.

facts.description: Fact IDs attached to the whole category (the "Did you know?" line under the design table).

category_params.description: Numbers that belong to the category rather than to one option.

structural_ratio_by_propellant.description: Tank structural ratio by propellant (design section 7.9): dry tank mass = propellant mass x ratio x material multiplier.

design_notes.description: Designer-facing notes about ambiguities or decisions. Never shown to players and never localised.

parts.description: The options of the category, in design-table order.

part.description: One selectable option of a part category.

category.description: Category of the option; must equal the category of the file.

name_key.description: String key of the generic in-game name.

twin.description: String key of the real-world twin line. Omit when the design table shows none.

strengths.description: String keys of the Strengths bullets, in display order. Empty when the design lists none.

drawbacks.description: String keys of the Drawbacks bullets, in display order. Always shown on the Part Card.

facts.description: Fact IDs offered as the "Did you know?" line of the Part Card.

contracts.description: Contracts that offer this option. Omit when the design does not restrict it; the option is then available wherever its category is voted.

model.description: Path of the 3D model relative to the model root, models/<id>.glb.

stats.description: Physical and performance figures of the option. The allowed fields depend on category (see the allOf block).

modifiers.description: Multipliers and deltas the option applies to the whole vehicle or mission, for example a dry-mass multiplier.

rules.description: Hooks for dependencies and side effects: required parts, anomaly weights, enabled minigames, test-mitigated risks, flags.

oneOf.description: The option needs another part, for example propulsive booster landing requires grid fins.

part.description: Part that must also be chosen.

oneOf.description: The option needs at least one of several parts.

parts.description: Parts of which at least one must also be chosen.

oneOf.description: The option cannot be combined with another part.

part.description: Part that cannot be combined with this one.

oneOf.description: Choosing the option makes an anomaly card more likely (design section 6.8).

anomaly.description: Anomaly card whose draw weight this option raises.

weight_mult.description: Multiplier on the card draw weight (game value). Omit while the design only says "more likely".

oneOf.description: Choosing the option enables a minigame.

minigame.description: Minigame that becomes possible when this option is chosen.

oneOf.description: The option carries a failure mode unless a named test is run.

failure_mode.description: Failure mode the option is exposed to.

test.description: Test that removes or reveals the risk.

with_propellant.description: Restricts the risk to builds using this propellant.

oneOf.description: The Part Card recommends a test for this option.
A qualitative effect with no number in the design.

failure_modes.description: Failure modes this option can roll at flight checkpoints (design section 8.4).

value_types.description: Provenance tag for every numeric group of the option.

design_notes.description: Designer-facing notes about ambiguities or decisions. Never shown to players and never localised.

game.description: Game-balance figures (design section 7.0). A field is omitted when the design table has no value for it.

cost_M.description: Contribution of the option to build cost, in game $M (not a real price).

lead_days.description: Procurement lead time in days. Lead times run in parallel: only the longest counts.

integ_days.description: Contribution to serial integration time in days. Integration days add up; a negative value speeds integration up.

reliability.description: Displayed base reliability per flight as a fraction (0.985 = 98.5%). The hidden true value lies within the maturity band.

maturity.description: Maturity level; sets the uncertainty band: proven +-1%, mature +-3%, new +-6%.

value_types.description: Provenance tags; {} for an option without numbers. Each group that contains a number needs a tag; a single field can override its group with a dotted key such as stats.eastward_boost_m_s.

modifiers.description: Tag of the modifiers group; a modifier can override it with its own value_type.

rules.description: Tag of the numeric values inside rules (anomaly weight multipliers).

^(stats|game)\\.[a-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*$.description: Tag of one field, overriding the tag of its group.

latitude_deg.description: Site latitude in degrees, positive north.

eastward_boost_m_s.description: Free eastward speed from Earth rotation at the site, in m/s: 465 m/s x cos(latitude).

min_inclination_deg.description: Lowest orbital inclination the site reaches efficiently, in degrees. Present only where the design states it.

power_duty.description: When power_W is drawn: continuous, or during_imaging only.

requires_cooling.description: True if the detector must be kept cold (thermal penalty).

data_GB_per_day.description: Data generated per day in GB.

sees_through_clouds.description: True if the instrument images through cloud. Present only where the design states it.

works_at_night.description: True if the instrument images at night. Present only where the design states it.

pointing_accuracy_deg.description: Pointing accuracy in degrees (smaller is better).

mass_t.description: Capsule mass in tonnes, without service module.

service_module_mass_t.description: Service module mass in tonnes, where the option has one.

cargo_capacity_t.description: Cargo capacity in tonnes when flown uncrewed.

endurance_days.description: Crewed endurance in days, where the design states it.

loop_type.description: open_loop = consumables only; regenerative = regenerative CO2 removal.

landing_method_key.description: String key of the landing method text.

max_entry_speed_km_s.description: Rated entry speed in km/s. A table value of "~11+" is stored as 11.

mass_t.description: Shield mass in tonnes for the reference capsule.

reference_capsule_mass_t.description: Capsule mass in tonnes that mass_t was quoted for (9 in the design).

reusable.description: Reusability column of the design table.

carried_all_flight.description: True if the mass stays aboard for the whole flight; false if it is jettisoned.

jettison_time_s.description: Seconds after lift-off at which the system is jettisoned, when it is.

abort_envelope_key.description: String key of the abort envelope text.

abort_envelope_max.description: Last flight regime in which an abort is possible; every option covers the pad.

reusable.description: True if the fairing can be recovered for a refund.

stats_engine_count.description: Engine count and clustering stats (design section 7.6).

engine_count.description: Number of engines on the stage.

engine_out_capability.description: Engine-out capable? column: no, partial (if TWR allows), usually, yes.

engine_out_bonus.description: Size of the engine-out bonus named in the table.

stats_first_stage_engine.description: First-stage engine stats (design section 7.7). Thrust and Isp are for one engine.

propellant.description: Propellant combination burned by the engine.

thrust_sl_kN.description: Sea-level thrust of one engine in kN.

thrust_vac_kN.description: Vacuum thrust of one engine in kN.

mass_t.description: Dry mass of one engine in tonnes.

throttle_min.description: Lowest throttle setting as a fraction of rated thrust (0.40 = 40%). 1 for a fixed-thrust engine.

throttle_max.description: Highest throttle setting as a fraction of rated thrust (1.09 = 109%).

stats_upper_stage_engine.description: Upper-stage engine stats (design section 7.8). Thrust and Isp are for one engine.

propellant.description: Propellant combination burned by the engine.

thrust_vac_kN.description: Vacuum thrust of one engine in kN.

mass_t.description: Dry mass of one engine in tonnes.

fixed_propellant_t.description: Fixed propellant load in tonnes for motors that ignore the tank vote (solid kick motor).

throttle_min.description: Lowest throttle setting as a fraction of rated thrust, where the design gives one.

throttle_max.description: Highest throttle setting as a fraction of rated thrust, where the design gives one.

stats_tank_size.description: Tank size stats (design section 7.9). One entry serves both stage votes.

first_stage_propellant_t.description: Propellant capacity in tonnes when chosen for the first stage.

upper_stage_propellant_t.description: Propellant capacity in tonnes when chosen for the upper stage.

stats_structural_material.description: Structural material (design section 7.10). No per-part stats: the dry-mass and cost multipliers live in modifiers and the integration days in game.integ_days.

booster_count.description: Number of boosters in the option (0 for None).

thrust_sl_each_kN.description: Sea-level thrust of one booster in kN.

mass_each_t.description: Mass of one booster in tonnes.

cost_each_M.description: Cost of one booster in game $M, as printed in the table; game.cost_M holds the total for the option.

mirrors_first_stage.description: True if thrust, burn time and mass of each booster equal the first stage as built (liquid side boosters).

cost_first_stage_mult.description: Cost of the option as a multiple of the first-stage cost (2 for liquid side boosters).

computer_count.description: Number of flight computers, for the redundancy formula of design section 6.5.

insertion_error_km.description: Orbit insertion error in km (plus or minus).

precise_attitude.description: True if the option gives precise attitude knowledge.

add_on_to.description: Part ID this option extends, for add-on options such as terrain-relative navigation.

stats_aero_control.description: Aerodynamic control (design section 7.15). No numeric stats in the design; effects are expressed through game.cost_M, rules and flags.

best_for_key.description: String key of the Best for column.

data_rate_GB_per_pass.description: Data downlinked per ground pass in GB.

continuous_coverage.description: True if the option removes the wait for ground passes (relay network).

stats_booster_recovery.description: Booster recovery (design section 7.18). No per-part stats: the delta-v cost and refund live in modifiers.

stats_capsule_recovery.description: Capsule or payload recovery (design section 7.19). No numeric stats in the design.

stats_mission_assurance.description: Mission assurance level (design section 7.20). No per-part stats: all effects live in modifiers.
